text:
leo-sales: Heads-up — BigTel wants to run a 30-day POC. Must be: EU-only processing, control plane residency inside EU, BYOK via customer HSM, and a notarized sub-processor list. AE asked for a short presales packet with options and costs. Can ops + legal + pricing help?

marine-ops: Quick take: three options: hosted+geo-pin (fast), dedicated EU reserved pool (mid), or full Private (control-plane + data-plane in-customer/EU) for strict residency. Need to confirm if 'control plane in EU' means vendor-managed EU control plane is acceptable or customer-managed only.

greg-legal: If they require vendor control-plane to reside in EU, hosted won't comply without Private. I'll pull the subproc export and SOC2 dates; also need to prepare a DPA addendum. Who is the customer contact for cert acceptance?

hana-pricing: I can sketch cost delta. Need POC traffic numbers: QPS, token distribution, model size.

leo-sales: POC numbers: baseline 4 qps, spikes to 25 qps for short bursts, avg 140 tokens/request, model target: 13B quant. POC duration: 30 days.

dev-engr: Model note: 13B quant fits on a single EU node; expect ~220ms median token latency at that QPS if batching is small. Will add quant fallback suggestion.

ops-bot: Presales template snippet:
```
routing: "tenant_pin: eu-west-1"
control_plane: "eu_only: true/false"
kms: "BYOK-HSM: external(mTLS, cert_exchange)"
fallback: "fallback_model: quant-smaller"
network: "ip_allowlist, peering, nat, egress_routes"
```
Include a note: hosted+BYOK needs outbound TLS to customer HSM endpoints.

marine-ops: Ops caveats: hosted+BYOK => we must open egress to customer HSM and validate mTLS certs; some telcos block outbound HSM connections, which forces a Private/VPC connector. Also, fallback behavior: if BYOK path fails we need an agreed contingency.

greg-legal: For BYOK-HSM we require evidence keys never leave customer control — envelope encryption with customer KEK is supported, but attestation is much simpler on Private. I'll prepare the DPA addendum and a subproc attestation pack.

hana-pricing: Rough ballpark for the POC (subject to finance review):
- HOSTED+GEO_PIN: ~2.1k/month + one-time network setup ~3.2k
- DEDICATED EU RESERVED: ~7.5k/month + onboarding ~2k
- PRIVATE (EU control plane): ~15k/month + integration SOW ~7k and 3-6 week lead time
I'll call out BYOK-HSM SOW separately (~5-8k depending on complexity).

leo-sales: Good. Can we make a 1-page decision table (security, compliance, cost, lead-time, recommended for POC) to send to AE?

dev-engr: I'll add a short appendix: expected latency numbers and the recommended quant profile for the 13B to keep P95 under 1.2s.

marine-ops: I'll produce an ops checklist: network ports, cert exchange steps, test plan for HSM connectivity, failover plan, and estimated setup time per option.

greg-legal: I'll attach the subproc export + SOC2 cert timestamps and the DPA draft. Requesting customer contact for signature flow.

leo-sales: Action list: @hana prepare one-pager, @marine ops checklist + lead times, @greg subproc + DPA, @dev-engr latency appendix. I'll schedule a 20m pre-brief with AE for tomorrow 09:00 CET. Thanks! :v:
